lead.event: OJK sets a 120% minimum solvency ratio for insurers
lead.headline: OJK sets insurers’ minimum solvency ratio at 120%
lead.blurb: OJK issued the regulation on 26 October, requiring insurers designated as Domestic Significantly Important Insurers to hold additional capital equal to 15% of risk-based minimum capital (MMBR). It also sets rules for capital classification and risk calculations, and requires annual stress tests and audited solvency reports. The new calculation applies from first-quarter 2027 reports, while sanctions for breaches begin with first-quarter 2028 reporting.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions 10 capital-market violation cases and orders illicit gains returned
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK sanctions 10 market cases and orders Rp23.77 billion returned
market_structure_policy.blurb: The cases included share-trading manipulation at Grand House Mulia, Saraswanti Anugerah Makmur and Suryamas Dutamakmur, as well as disclosure, reporting and transaction breaches. OJK also imposed Rp3.71 billion in fines and barred Hermanto from capital-market, derivatives and carbon-exchange activities for 10 years in the Grand House Mulia case.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: OJK barred Hermanto from capital-market, derivatives and carbon-exchange activities for 10 years.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia reports Q3 savings balance and net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports Rp634.8tn savings and Rp48.2tn Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI's savings balance topped BCA's Rp628.4 trillion, reversing a Rp45.9 trillion gap in March 2025. Net profit rose 16.8% year on year, making BRI Indonesia's most profitable bank.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia targets 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI targets around 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI plans to revive Kupedes micro lending, optimize capital and sustain dividends, with a short-term ROE target of 17%-18%. Management considers a payout ratio of around 60% sustainable and targets a stable dividend per share for fiscal 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Gold Resources reports nine-month losses and Pani mine production outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS reports US$19 million nine-month loss as Pani run rate reaches 147,000 ounces
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Gold Resources attributed the loss to timing differences between production and sales recognition and tax expenses. It expects 165,000-180,000 ounces in 2027, after 85,000-100,000 ounces under 2026 guidance.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The annualized production run rate reached about 147,000 ounces in early October 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Battery Materials reports record third-quarter earnings
earnings_guidance.headline: MBMA reports record Q3 earnings, with profit up 372% to US$92 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials reported nine-month profit of US$146 million, versus US$25 million a year earlier. Q3 revenue rose 138% to US$732 million and EBITDA climbed 276% to US$238 million, supported by record nickel ore output of 12.3 million wet metric tonnes.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Semen Indonesia announces a Rp250 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SMGR announces Rp250 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Semen Indonesia plans to fund the repurchase with internal cash, not IPO proceeds or debt, and cap it at 20% of placed and paid-up capital. It will begin no later than three months after the announcement.
